positions.title: Visualization Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Currently utilizing Unreal Engine 5 and C++ to create immersive visualizations of oceanic elements, such as modeling seal sleep patterns and accurately simulating complex wave patterns.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Contributed to the development of a virtual reality Unreal Engine 5 project creating custom C++ functions, integrating it seamlessly with a
React webpage built using JavaScript and Vite with a primary focus on immersive archaeology visualization.
• Established a CouchDB database housing an extensive repository of 1000s of files containing loci and artifact
data, seamlessly accessible and queryable via the React webpage interface.
• Designed and implemented a specialized KML/XML file reader for archaeological data, converting it into
JSON format, to be stored within the CouchDB database for efficient management and retrieval.
• Boosted rendering efficiency by 50% through the development of a high-performance voxel generator primarily
for loci generation.
